Netflix cut ad goal

lines.text: Netflix cut its 2026 ad forecast by $300 million.
lines.say: Netflix cut its twenty twenty-six ad forecast by three hundred million dollars.

lines.text: That's from its third-quarter report Tuesday, and the main numbers mostly hit the mark.
lines.say: That's from its third-quarter report Tuesday, and the main numbers mostly hit the mark.

lines.text: Revenue was $12.87 billion, in line with its own $12.86 billion forecast.
lines.say: Revenue was twelve point eight seven billion, in line with its forecast of twelve point eight six billion.

lines.text: Profit was 87 cents a share, up from 59 cents a year earlier.
lines.say: Profit was eighty-seven cents a share, up from fifty-nine cents a year earlier.

lines.text: Netflix says more members and higher prices drove most of that growth.
lines.say: Netflix says more members and higher prices drove most of that growth.

lines.text: Ads are the weak spot. It now expects about $2.7 billion in 2026, down from about $3 billion.
lines.say: Ads are the weak spot. It now expects about two point seven billion in twenty twenty-six, down from about three billion.

lines.text: Netflix blamed a slower rollout of some ad features.
lines.say: Netflix blamed a slower rollout of some ad features.

lines.text: For October through December, it forecasts $13.44 billion, just under the $13.51 billion analysts expected.
lines.say: For October through December, it forecasts thirteen point four four billion, just under the thirteen point five one billion analysts expected.

lines.text: So by Netflix's own account, subscriptions still do the heavy lifting.

post.title: Netflix cut its 2026 ad forecast by $300 million
post.ig:
Netflix cut its 2026 ad forecast by $300 million.
Q3 2026 revenue was $12.87 billion (+12%), in line with its own $12.86 billion forecast; profit was $0.87 a share vs $0.59 a year earlier.
Netflix says more members and higher prices drove most of that growth.
It now expects about $2.7 billion in 2026 ad revenue, down from about $3 billion, citing a slower rollout of some ad tools. Q4 revenue forecast: $13.44 billion vs $13.51 billion expected by analysts.
Sources: Netflix Q3 2026 shareholder letter (Oct 20, 2026), Variety, MediaPost, Yahoo Finance.
